972 asáu 'that' RV. with its obl. cases from the st. amu-, esp. gen. amúṣya formed the basis of MIA. and NIA. remote demonstratives.
    Pa. asu: amussa, Pk. ahō: amussa Pischel GrPk § 432; Gy. eur. ov, ō 'he, that, the' Sampson DGW iv 247; Pr. sū 'he', obl. miš; Wg. amī 'these' (< nom. pl. m. amī́?); K. huh, dat. humis, dir. pl. hum; S. ho; L. o: us, ũ, P. o: aus, us; WPah. bhal. o: ɔs, us; N. u: us; MB. oū: ohā; H. wah: us; OMarw. vo: ũ; Si. ū: ohu.
    amuka-.
    Addenda: asáu: S.kcch. ū 'he, that'.
